newClaim.claimText: VU Amsterdam student examinations guidance establishes that instructors cannot require students to use unlicensed AI applications (such as ChatGPT, Claude, or Grok), while identifying authorized tools covered by formal institutional data processing agreements: Microsoft Copilot for Web, Google Gemini and Gemini Notebook (under Google Workspace for Education Fundamentals), Cogniti on Azure, and integrated didactical tools (Canvas, FeedbackFruits, Writefull), provided students log in with VU credentials and never submit sensitive personal or research data.
newClaim.claimValue: Teachers cannot require unlicensed AI tools; formal data processing agreements cover VU-licensed Microsoft Copilot for Web, Google Gemini / Gemini Notebook, and Cogniti, with no human chat review or model training when logged in with VU credentials.

evidence.evidenceSnippet: VU Amsterdam has a contract and a data processing agreement with the supplier Google. These contain all kinds of provisions that prohibit the supplier from using personal data of VU employees and VU students for their own purposes, such as reselling. Gemini and Gemini Notebook (formerly NotebookLM) are core services covered by the Google Workspace for Education Fundamentals Terms of Service. If you use your Google Workspace for Education account with Gemini and Gemini Notebook, your chats will not be reviewed by human moderators and will not be used in any other way to improve generative AI models. To use this chatbot securely, log in with your VU credentials.

sourceChanges.citationTitle: Generative AI, Copilot, Gemini and ChatGPT
How to deal with ChatGPT and Microsoft Copilot as a teacher
Kader voor generatieve AI in het onderwijs

claimChanges.claimText: VU Amsterdam student examinations guidance establishes that instructors cannot require students to use unlicensed AI applications (such as ChatGPT, Claude, or Grok), while identifying authorized tools covered by formal institutional data processing agreements: Microsoft Copilot for Web, Google Gemini and Gemini Notebook (under Google Workspace for Education Fundamentals), Cogniti on Azure, and integrated didactical tools (Canvas, FeedbackFruits, Writefull), provided students log in with VU credentials and never submit sensitive personal or research data.
Microsoft Copilot is listed for Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam in an official university AI tools source. Derived availability: allowed. Derived endorsement type: not specified.

VU Amsterdam's framework says students cannot be required to use AI tools for which VU has no license, and students, lecturers, and support staff do not process personal data or other confidential data in AI tools.
VU Amsterdam's framework says AI detectors are not permitted because they are unreliable and do not meet VU privacy requirements.

VU Amsterdam's framework says the lecturer or examiner indicates in the study guide, syllabus, or Canvas whether and how use of generative AI is allowed for a course, with course learning objectives remaining leading.

VU Amsterdam's research guidance says GenAI use in research must meet scientific-research standards, take existing VU policies on ownership, scientific integrity, privacy, personal data, and knowledge security into account, and be transparent about which parts of research used GenAI.
VU Amsterdam's Dutch academic-integrity page states that work made by generative AI is not the student's own work and lists using an AI writer to write an assignment as an example of fraud.

VU Amsterdam's April 2025 Dutch framework describes the university's vision and policy for generative AI in education and gives faculties conditions for formulating their own faculty AI education policy.

VU Amsterdam's student guidance states that Microsoft Copilot is available to VU students and staff through VU credentials, that teachers cannot force ChatGPT use, and that teachers may ask students to use Microsoft Copilot via the VU license.

VU Amsterdam's Cogniti page describes Cogniti as an online-learning platform offered by VU where teachers or staff can create generative AI Agents for students, integrated into Canvas or used stand-alone at edubots.vu.nl in some cases.
